name: Career Ops - Ollama Codex Gemini Supervisor

parameters.content:
## Career Ops - Ollama Codex/Gemini Supervisor

n8n is the automation surface. Paulo's local Ollama model is the first intelligence layer. It reviews the latest local automation outputs hourly, then decides whether to queue or call Codex/Gemini.

Endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:18767/triage-latest`.

Default mode: queue-only. `N8N_OLLAMA_CODEX_AUTORUN=false` and `N8N_OLLAMA_GEMINI_AUTORUN=false` mean neither Codex nor Gemini runs automatically.

Routing: Codex is for local patches/tests/integration. Gemini API is last-resort/report-only and requires an explicit fallback reason. Workspace-write autorun is Codex-only and additionally requires `N8N_OLLAMA_CODEX_ALLOW_WORKSPACE_WRITE=true` plus low-risk Ollama triage.

Hard gates remain active: no secrets, push, merge, deploy, production, paid ads, App Store/TestFlight, social publishing, migrations, force push, secret rotation, bulk Linear changes, proposal submission, credit spend, boost, platform messaging, login/CAPTCHA/2FA bypass, payment or profile changes without Paulo approval.
